name: George Leo Haydock
bio:
English Catholic priest, trained at Douai and at Crook Hall near Durham, who served missions in Lancashire and Yorkshire.

His notes to the Douay-Rheims Bible (1811-14) gather the comments of earlier Catholic interpreters, each marked with a letter (C. for Calmet, W. for Worthington, Ch. for Challoner), and his own, marked H.; reprinted through the 1800s, the Haydock Bible was the standard family Bible of English-speaking Catholics.
